View size (landscape for animals, portrait for humanoids)

widgets_values:
ONE IMAGE -> TEXTURED 3D (Qwen-Image 2.1 edit + Pixal3D multi-view)

How to use:
1. Load a character image (any pose or angle; full body works best).
2. Fill in 'subject' (short name) and 'details' (key features: head, colors, legs, tail). English.
3. View size: 1280x960 for animals / long creatures, 960x1280 for humanoids.
4. Run with node 3a mode = 'generate'. Check 'views_normalized': order is front | left | back | right.
5. Want to try other view combinations without waiting for Qwen? Set node 3a mode = 'reuse saved',
   toggle include_front / include_back and Run. Qwen does not run at all, only the 3D part (~3 min).
   - Double face / missing eyes / grinning front -> include_front OFF.
   - Long snouts (shark, horse, crocodile): start with include_front OFF.
   - Odd back view -> include_back OFF.
   - Views switched off in 'generate' mode are not generated either (~1.5 min saved per view).
   - Right side = mirror of the left side (mirror_other_side), so both flanks always match.
6. Output: output/3d/mv3d_*.glb. The last views are kept in output/mv3d/latest/ (side/front/back.png).
   New character? Switch node 3a back to 'generate' (or change the folder so old views are kept).

Requires: custom_nodes/comfyui-multiview-kit and ComfyUI-GGUF (for the GGUF Qwen loader).
